_comment: Text the vendored English shell paints that is not the English pivot.
dashboard-en.html was translated by hand from the Italian shell and the pass
was never finished: an English user reads '⚡ Energy Erogata (da HA)' and
'Consumo Total' to this day. Re-translating the vendored file is not an
option — it is regenerated from upstream — so each broken string is mapped
onto the key it should have had. The DOM pass then repairs it in English and
carries it into every other language, which is the same path Italian takes.
Left: what the shell actually says. Right: a key in the corpus.
Entries whose left side is Italian are strings the English pass missed
entirely; entries that read like English are the half-finished ones.
